Hi, Welcome to the Google Photos Help Forum.
 
You can follow these steps to restore your photos and videos:
  1. On your usage device, open the Google Photos app.
  2. At the bottom, tap Collections > Trash.
    • If the photo or video isn’t in your trash, it may be permanently deleted.
  3. Touch and hold the photo or video you want to restore.
  4. At the bottom, tap Restore. Your photo or video will be back in:
    • Albums that it was in
    • Google Photos library
    • Phone’s gallery app
 
Also, you won't be able to restore a photo if:
  • You moved it to trash more than 60 days ago.
  • You moved it to trash more than 30 days ago on an Android 11 and up device and it wasn’t backed up.
  • Recovery is not guaranteed. No one can guarantee a 100% successful recovery.
 
If you mean permanently deleted videos/photos from the Trash or Locked Folder, you can use the following recovery process: Restore recently deleted photos & videos.
 
Regards,
Mokit
